description: Wait for a condition before proceeding. Supports: element visible, text appears, network idle, URL navigation, JS expression truthy. Returns a fresh snapshot after the wait completes.

js.description: JS expression that should return truthy (for js condition).

target.description: @eN ref or CSS selector (for element/text conditions).

text.description: Text to find (for text condition) or URL pattern (for navigation).

timeout.description: Max wait time in ms. Default 10000, max 30000.

name: wait_for
title: Smart Wait
